brief: Second attempt for three of the five (submission SUB-ATLAS-2026-11-15-US-LEADS-OFFICIAL): the Fabric refused them as duplicates of their own leads, because a lead held the provision's key and nothing let a record replace it. With lead promotion in the Reasoning Fabric (reasoning_fabric #13, deployed first), the same records and evidence are proposed again under new ids; on approval each replaces its lead, which is closed. New York's and Colorado's went through in the first attempt because their state codes changed their key.
